An Act to deal with consequential matters arising from the enactment of the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund Act 2018, and for other purposes

content.p: This Act is the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund (Consequential Amendments) Act 2018.

Each provision of this Act specified in column 1 of the table commences, or is taken to have commenced, in accordance with column 2 of the table. Any other statement in column 2 has effect according to its terms.

tr.td: 1. Sections 1 to 3 and anything in this Act not elsewhere covered by this table
The day this Act receives the Royal Assent.
At the same time as the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund Act 2018 commences. However, the provisions do not commence at all if that Act does not commence.

At the same time as the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund Act 2018 commences. However, the provisions do not commence at all if: (a) Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the Nation-building Funds Repeal (National Disability Insurance Scheme Funding) Act 2018 commences before the commencement of the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund Act 2018; or (b) the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund Act 2018 does not commence.

The later of: (a) immediately after the commencement of the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund Act 2018; and (b) the commencement of Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the Nation-building Funds Repeal (National Disability Insurance Scheme Funding) Act 2018. However, the provisions do not commence at all unless both of the events mentioned in paragraphs (a) and (b) occur.

The later of: (a) immediately after the commencement of the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund Act 2018; and (b) the commencement of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Amendment (Indigenous Land Corporation) Act 2018. However, the provisions do not commence at all unless both of the events mentioned in paragraphs (a) and (b) occur.
The day after this Act receives the Royal Assent.

content.p: Note: This table relates only to the provisions of this Act as originally enacted. It will not be amended to deal with any later amendments of this Act.
Any information in column 3 of the table is not part of this Act. Information may be inserted in this column, or information in it may be edited, in any published version of this Act.

Legislation that is specified in a Schedule to this Act is amended or repealed as set out in the applicable items in the Schedule concerned, and any other item in a Schedule to this Act has effect according to its terms.
